decided: When a program the user has already signed off gets a newer copy of its brief, the user is asked again in every pull-request mode only if a change belonging to the program was archived after the closing review the signature was given under, meaning the program was reopened with new work. Running the closing review again with no new work in between is treated like any other later copy: asked again only while the program pull request can still be marked ready.
alternatives: ask again in every mode whenever a newer closing review is recorded
never ask again because of a closing review, so a reopened program under per-proposal is never asked about its new work
why: A signature should cover the work the user read; work archived after it is new, while a review run again over the same work adds nothing the user has not signed, and asking then would contradict the earlier decision that a signed program is not asked again once nothing is left to hold.
